zh: 我刚到办公室。
en: I've just got to the office.
alt: I just got to the office.
I've just arrived at the office.
point: 刚… → have just + 过去分词，NZ 口语常说 got to

zh: 我八点就到这儿了。
en: I've been here since eight.
alt: I've been here since eight o'clock.
point: 从八点到现在一直在 → have been here since，不是 I came here at eight

zh: 我密码忘了。
en: I've forgotten my password.
alt: I forgot my password.
point: 忘了（现在还想不起来）→ have forgotten

zh: 我在重启电脑，等一下。
en: I'm just restarting my computer, hang on.
alt: Hang on, I'm rebooting my laptop.
point: 正在做 → am + -ing，别漏掉 am

zh: 我们已经点了。
en: We've already ordered.
alt: We already ordered.
point: 已经… → have already + 过去分词

zh: 你吃过青口吗？
en: Have you ever tried green-lipped mussels?
alt: Have you ever had green-lipped mussels?
point: 问经历「…过吗」→ Have you ever…？不用 Did you eat

zh: 上周末我去打羽毛球了。
en: I played badminton last weekend.
alt: I went and played badminton last weekend.
point: 上周末 → 一般过去时；「去打」不必译成 went to play

zh: 我好几年没游泳了。
en: I haven't been swimming for years.
alt: I haven't swum in years.
point: 好几年没… → haven't done for years，用完成时

zh: 我在找冬天穿的外套。
en: I'm looking for a winter jacket.
alt: I'm after a winter coat.
point: 正在找 → I'm looking for，不是 I find / I look for

zh: 等一下，我去问问店员。
en: Hang on, I'll ask one of the staff.
alt: Just a sec, I'll go and ask someone.
point: 说话时当场决定 → I'll，不用 I'm going to

zh: 我从来没坐过邮轮。
en: I've never been on a cruise.
alt: I've never done a cruise.
point: 从来没…过 → have never been on，不是 never took

zh: 我们是上周五到的惠灵顿。
en: We got to Wellington last Friday.
alt: We arrived in Wellington last Friday.
point: 「是…的」讲过去的事 → 一般过去时；arrive in + 城市

zh: 我感冒三天了。
en: I've had a cold for three days.
alt: I've had this cold for three days now.
point: 感冒三天了（还没好）→ have had a cold for

zh: 我下午要去看医生。
en: I'm seeing the doctor this afternoon.
alt: I've got a doctor's appointment this afternoon.
I'm going to the doctor this afternoon.
point: 已经约好的安排 → 现在进行时 I'm seeing

zh: 你晚饭吃了吗？
en: Have you had dinner yet?
alt: Have you eaten yet?
point: 吃了吗 → Have you had…yet？yet 放句末

zh: 洗衣机坏了。
en: The washing machine's broken down.
alt: The washing machine's stopped working.
point: 坏了（现在还坏着）→ has broken down，不是 is break

zh: 你最近在忙什么？
en: What have you been up to?
alt: What have you been up to lately?
point: 最近在忙什么 → have been up to，完成进行时

zh: 我昨天碰到你同事了。
en: I ran into your colleague yesterday.
alt: I bumped into your workmate yesterday.
point: 碰到 → ran into，run 的过去式是 ran

zh: 我下个月要涨工资了。
en: I'm getting a pay rise next month.
alt: I'm getting a raise next month.
point: 已经定了的事 → I'm getting；涨工资 → pay rise

zh: 油价又涨了。
en: Petrol's gone up again.
alt: Petrol prices have gone up again.
point: 涨了（现在更贵）→ has gone up；汽油 → petrol

zh: 我给他发了好几封邮件，到现在都没回音。
en: I've emailed him a few times, but I still haven't heard back.
alt: I've sent him several emails and he still hasn't got back to me.
point: 到现在还没 → still haven't，still 放在 haven't 前

zh: 我打电话过去的时候，她正在给客户做演示。
en: She was presenting to a client when I rang.
alt: When I called, she was in the middle of a client presentation.
point: 打电话时她正在… → was doing + when + 过去时

zh: 这个bug我从早上弄到现在。
en: I've been working on this bug since this morning.
alt: I've been trying to fix this bug since this morning.
point: 从早上一直到现在 → have been doing since

zh: 新版本下周二上线，到时候我通知大家。
en: The new version goes live next Tuesday, and I'll let everyone know.
alt: The new version's going live next Tuesday, and I'll let you all know.
point: 时间表上定好的事可用一般现在时 goes live

zh: 我们都等了四十分钟了，菜还没影儿。
en: We've been waiting for forty minutes and there's still no sign of our food.
alt: We've been waiting forty minutes and our food still hasn't come.
point: 等了四十分钟（还在等）→ have been waiting

zh: 你吃完了吗？我帮你把盘子收了。
en: Have you finished with that? I'll take your plate for you.
alt: Are you done with that? I'll grab your plate.
point: 吃完了吗 → Have you finished；主动帮忙 → I'll

zh: 我们到球场的时候，下半场已经开始了。
en: By the time we got to the ground, the second half had already started.
alt: When we got to the stadium, the second half had already started.
point: 到的时候已经… → had already done，过去的过去

zh: 周六全黑队打澳洲，你看吗？
en: The All Blacks are playing Australia on Saturday. Are you going to watch it?
alt: The All Blacks play Australia on Saturday. Are you watching?
point: 定好的赛事 → are playing；你看吗 → are you going to

zh: 这个水壶我上周在The Warehouse买的，已经坏了。
en: I bought this kettle at The Warehouse last week, and it's already stopped working.
alt: I only got this kettle from The Warehouse last week and it's already broken.
point: 上周买的 → 过去时；已经坏了 → has stopped working

zh: 我十天前在网上下的单，到现在还没到。
en: I ordered it online ten days ago, and it hasn't turned up yet.
alt: I ordered it online ten days ago and it still hasn't arrived.
point: 十天前 → ago 配过去时；还没到 → hasn't turned up yet

zh: 我们本来打算开车去米尔福德峡湾，结果路封了。
en: We were going to drive to Milford Sound, but the road was closed.
alt: We'd planned to drive to Milford Sound, but the road was closed.
point: 本来打算 → was going to，后面常接 but

zh: 这是我第一次来南岛，风景太美了。
en: This is the first time I've been to the South Island, and the scenery's stunning.
alt: It's my first time in the South Island, and the scenery's amazing.
point: 这是第一次来 → the first time I've been，要用完成时

zh: 我上个月把脚踝扭了，现在还有点疼。
en: I sprained my ankle last month and it's still a bit sore.
alt: I rolled my ankle last month and it still hurts a bit.
point: 上个月扭伤 → 过去时；现在还疼 → it's still sore

zh: 我最近一直在吃维生素D，感觉好些了。
en: I've been taking vitamin D lately, and I'm feeling a bit better.
alt: I've been on vitamin D for a while now and I feel a bit better.
point: 最近一直在 → have been taking；吃药、维生素用 take

zh: 昨晚我正看着电视呢，突然停电了。
en: The power went out last night while I was watching TV.
alt: I was watching TV last night when the power went out.
point: 正在…突然 → while + 过去进行时，突发的事用过去时

zh: 房东说下周会派人来修热水器。
en: The landlord says he'll send someone to fix the hot water cylinder next week.
alt: The landlord said he'd get someone round to fix the hot water next week.
point: 会派人 → he'll send；热水器在新西兰叫 hot water cylinder

zh: 他平时挺安静的，今晚话特别多。
en: He's usually pretty quiet, but he's being really chatty tonight.
alt: He's normally quite quiet, but he's really chatty tonight.
point: 平时 → 一般现在时；今晚一反常态 → is being

zh: 他们俩是大学时认识的，结婚十年了。
en: They met at uni and they've been married for ten years.
alt: They met at university and have been married for ten years now.
point: 认识 → met（过去）；结婚十年 → have been married for

zh: 还了八年，我的学生贷款终于还清了！
en: I've finally paid off my student loan after eight years!
alt: After eight years, I've finally paid off my student loan!
point: 还清了 → have paid off；finally 放在 have 后面

zh: 这个月我已经超支了，离发工资还有一个星期。
en: I've already gone over budget this month, and payday's still a week away.
alt: I've already blown my budget this month, and it's still a week till payday.
point: 已经超支 → have already gone over budget

zh: 这个项目已经拖了三个月了，客户那边开始有点坐不住了。
en: This project's been dragging on for three months, and the client's starting to get impatient.
alt: This project has dragged on for three months now, and the client is getting restless.
point: 拖了三个月（还在拖）→ has been dragging on

zh: 报告我上周就发给你了，你没收到吗？我现在再发一遍。
en: I sent you the report last week. Didn't you get it? I'll resend it now.
alt: I emailed the report to you last week. Did you not get it? I'll send it again now.
point: 上周 → 过去时，不用 have sent；再发一遍 → I'll

zh: 我们正在把服务器迁到云上，所以这个周末系统会停几个小时。
en: We're in the middle of migrating our servers to the cloud, so the system will be down for a few hours this weekend.
alt: We're moving our servers to the cloud at the moment, so the system's going to be down for a few hours this weekend.
point: 正在进行中 → in the middle of doing；会停 → will be down

zh: 等你明天上班的时候，补丁我应该已经推到所有机器上了。
en: By the time you get in tomorrow, I should have rolled the patch out to every machine.
alt: By the time you start work tomorrow, the patch should be on all the machines.
point: 到将来某时已完成 → (should) have done；by the time 后用现在时

zh: 我们订了七点的位子，可到了以后他们说没有我们的预订。
en: We'd booked a table for seven, but when we got there, they said they had no record of it.
alt: We'd made a booking for seven o'clock, but when we turned up they couldn't find it.
point: 先订位后到店 → had booked，过去的过去

zh: 这家餐厅开了快二十年了，我们家一直在这儿过生日。
en: This restaurant's been around for almost twenty years, and it's always been our go-to for family birthdays.
alt: This place has been open for nearly twenty years, and we've always come here for birthdays.
point: 开了二十年 → has been around，不说 opened twenty years

zh: 他去年膝盖受了伤，之后一直在做康复，希望下个赛季能回来。
en: He injured his knee last year and has been doing rehab ever since, so hopefully he'll be back next season.
alt: He hurt his knee last year and he's been in rehab ever since, so fingers crossed he's back next season.
point: 受伤 → 过去时；从那以后一直 → has been doing…ever since

zh: 我跑步跑了十年，但从来没跑过全马，明年打算试试。
en: I've been running for ten years, but I've never done a full marathon, so I'm going to give it a go next year.
alt: I've been a runner for ten years but never done a full marathon, so I'm planning to have a crack at one next year.
point: 跑了十年 → have been running；打算 → going to give it a go

zh: 我在这家店买东西买了好多年了，但最近服务明显变差了。
en: I've been shopping here for years, but the service has really gone downhill lately.
alt: I've shopped here for years, but the service has got noticeably worse recently.
point: 买了好多年 → have been shopping；变差 → has gone downhill

zh: 你昨天问的那款咖啡机今天早上到货了，要不要我给你留一台？
en: The coffee machine you were asking about yesterday came in this morning. Do you want me to put one aside for you?
alt: That coffee machine you asked about yesterday arrived this morning. Shall I keep one for you?
point: 你昨天问的 → were asking about；今早到货（有具体时间）→ 过去时

zh: 我们落地的时候，转机的航班已经飞走了，只好在悉尼住了一晚。
en: When we landed, our connecting flight had already left, so we ended up spending the night in Sydney.
alt: Our connection had already gone by the time we landed, so we had to stay the night in Sydney.
point: 落地时已经飞了 → had already left；只好 → ended up doing

zh: 下个月这个时候我就在日本滑雪了，我已经盼了好几个星期了。
en: This time next month I'll be skiing in Japan. I've been looking forward to it for weeks.
alt: I'll be skiing in Japan this time next month, and I've been counting down the weeks.
point: 下个月这时正在做 → will be doing；盼了好几周 → have been looking forward

zh: 我以前一天喝三杯咖啡，自从开始失眠以后就少喝多了。
en: I used to have three coffees a day, but I've cut right back since I started having trouble sleeping.
alt: I used to drink three coffees a day, but I've cut down a lot since I started struggling to sleep.
point: 以前常 → used to；自从…以后 → have done since + 过去时

zh: 我做完手术已经六个星期了，恢复得比我想的要快。
en: It's been six weeks since my operation, and I'm recovering faster than I expected.
alt: My operation was six weeks ago, and I'm healing quicker than I thought I would.
point: 已经六周了 → It's been six weeks since；正在恢复 → am recovering

zh: 我们搬进来的时候房子已经挺旧了，这几年我们一点一点在翻新。
en: The house was already pretty run-down when we moved in, and we've been doing it up bit by bit over the last few years.
alt: The place was quite run-down when we moved in, so we've been renovating it bit by bit ever since.
point: 这几年一点点在翻新 → have been doing it up；do up = 翻新

zh: 真巧，我正想给你发消息问你几点回家，你就进门了。
en: Funny, I was just about to text you to ask when you'd be home, and then you walked in.
alt: What timing, I was just going to message you to see when you'd be back, and in you walked.
point: 正要做…就 → was just about to…when；过去将来 you'd be

zh: 我们好几年没见了吧，上次见面好像还是在你的婚礼上。
en: We haven't seen each other for ages. I think the last time was at your wedding.
alt: It's been ages since we last caught up. I think it was at your wedding.
point: 好久没见 → haven't seen…for ages；上次 → was（过去时）

zh: 我原本打算周六去她的派对，后来临时有事去不了了。
en: I was planning to go to her party on Saturday, but something came up and I couldn't make it.
alt: I'd meant to go to her party on Saturday, but something came up and I couldn't go.
point: 原本打算 → was planning to；临时有事 → something came up

zh: 我们这几年一直在攒钱买房，可房价涨得比我们攒得还快。
en: We've been saving for a house for years, but prices have been climbing faster than we can save.
alt: We've been saving up for a house for years, but prices keep going up faster than we can save.
point: 一直在攒 → have been saving；一直在涨 → have been climbing

zh: 我下周一开始上新工作，所以这个月的工资会晚几天到账。
en: I'm starting a new job next Monday, so my pay will come through a few days late this month.
alt: I start my new job next Monday, so this month's pay is going to be a few days late.
point: 已定的安排 → I'm starting；会晚到 → will come through late

zh: 我今天已经开了三个会了。
en: I've had three meetings already today.
alt: I've already been in three meetings today.
point: 今天还没过完，已经…→ 现在完成时 have had，不用 had

zh: 电脑又死机了。
en: My computer's frozen again.
alt: My laptop's crashed again.
point: 死机了（现在还卡着）→ has frozen；freeze-froze-frozen

zh: 这家店我们来过。
en: We've been here before.
alt: We've eaten here before.
point: 来过 → have been here before，不说 have come here

zh: 你健身多久了？
en: How long have you been going to the gym?
alt: How long have you been working out?
point: …多久了 → How long have you been doing，不是 How long do you

zh: 那件夹克卖完了。
en: They've sold out of that jacket.
alt: That jacket's sold out.
point: 卖完了 → have sold out of，完成时表示现在没货

zh: 你去过皇后镇吗？
en: Have you been to Queenstown?
alt: Have you ever been to Queenstown?
point: 去过 → have been to；have gone to 是“去了还没回来”

zh: 我昨晚没睡好。
en: I didn't sleep well last night.
alt: I had a bad night's sleep last night.
point: 昨晚 → 过去时 didn't sleep，别用 haven't slept

zh: 水开了。
en: The kettle's boiled.
alt: The water's boiled.
point: 水开了 → The kettle's boiled，完成时，常用 kettle 作主语

zh: 好久不见，你一点没变！
en: Long time no see, you haven't changed a bit!
alt: It's been ages, and you haven't changed at all!
point: 一点没变（到现在）→ haven't changed a bit

zh: 我上个月花得太多了。
en: I spent way too much last month.
alt: I overspent last month.
point: 上个月 → 一般过去时 spent，不用完成时

zh: 我已经投了二十份简历了。
en: I've sent out twenty CVs so far.
alt: I've applied for twenty jobs so far.
point: 到目前为止已经 → have done…so far

zh: 我下周二有个面试。
en: I've got an interview next Tuesday.
alt: I'm having an interview next Tuesday.
point: 约好的面试 → I've got / I'm having，不说 I will interview

zh: 我昨天递了辞职信。
en: I handed in my notice yesterday.
alt: I resigned yesterday.
point: 昨天 → 过去时 handed in；辞职 → hand in my notice

zh: 我最近在备考雅思。
en: I'm studying for IELTS at the moment.
alt: I'm preparing for IELTS at the moment.
point: 这段时间在做 → 现在进行时，at the moment 也可用于一段时期

zh: 考试成绩出来了吗？
en: Have the exam results come out yet?
alt: Are the exam results out yet?
point: 出来了吗 → Have…come out yet？come 的过去分词还是 come

zh: 我学英语学了五年了。
en: I've been learning English for five years.
alt: I've studied English for five years.
point: 学了五年（还在学）→ have been learning for

zh: 我们刚搬进来。
en: We've just moved in.
alt: We only just moved in.
point: 刚搬进来 → have just moved in，just 放在 have 后

zh: 下个月房租要涨了。
en: The rent's going up next month.
alt: Our rent's increasing next month.
point: 已经通知的变化 → is going up，进行时表将来

zh: 押金我已经交了。
en: I've already paid the bond.
alt: I've paid the bond already.
point: 押金 → bond；已经交了 → have already paid

zh: 隔壁的狗昨晚叫了一夜。
en: The dog next door barked all night.
alt: The neighbour's dog was barking all night.
point: 昨晚叫了一夜（已结束）→ 过去时 barked all night

zh: 新邻居搬来了。
en: The new neighbours have moved in.
alt: Our new neighbours have arrived.
point: 搬来了（现在住着）→ have moved in

zh: 你认识楼上那家人吗？
en: Have you met the people upstairs?
alt: Do you know the people upstairs?
point: 认识（见过面）→ Have you met，不是 Do you meet

zh: 又停电了。
en: The power's gone off again.
alt: There's been another power cut.
point: 停电了 → The power's gone off，完成时，要补主语

zh: 网断了一上午了。
en: The internet's been down all morning.
alt: The Wi-Fi's been out all morning.
point: 断了一上午（还没好）→ has been down all morning

zh: 电费我还没交。
en: I haven't paid the power bill yet.
alt: I still haven't paid the power bill.
point: 还没交 → haven't…yet；电费 → power bill

zh: 水管工还没来。
en: The plumber hasn't turned up yet.
alt: The plumber still isn't here.
point: 还没来 → hasn't turned up yet，不说 doesn't come

zh: 冰箱漏水好几天了。
en: The fridge has been leaking for days.
alt: The fridge has been leaking for a few days now.
point: 漏了好几天（还在漏）→ has been leaking for days

zh: 我明天找人来修。
en: I'm getting someone in to fix it tomorrow.
alt: I've got someone coming to fix it tomorrow.
point: 已经安排好 → I'm getting someone in，进行时表计划

zh: 我的签证批下来了！
en: My visa's come through!
alt: My visa's been approved!
point: 批下来了 → has come through，完成时报告好消息

zh: 我的护照下个月到期。
en: My passport expires next month.
alt: My passport runs out next month.
point: 固定日期的事 → 一般现在时 expires 表将来

zh: 表格我昨天寄出去了。
en: I posted the form yesterday.
alt: I sent the form off yesterday.
point: 昨天 → 过去时 posted；寄信 → post

zh: 有人偷了我的钱包！
en: Someone's stolen my wallet!
alt: My wallet's been stolen!
point: 刚发现被偷 → Someone's stolen，完成时强调现在的结果

zh: 救护车马上就到。
en: The ambulance will be here any minute.
alt: The ambulance is on its way.
point: 马上就到 → will be here any minute

zh: 刚才地震了，你感觉到了吗？
en: Did you feel that earthquake just now?
alt: Did you feel the earthquake just then?
point: 刚才 just now → 用过去时 Did you，不用 Have you

zh: 我的车今早打不着火。
en: My car wouldn't start this morning.
alt: My car didn't start this morning.
point: 过去怎么也打不着 → wouldn't start

zh: 我开车开了十年了。
en: I've been driving for ten years.
alt: I've had my licence for ten years.
point: 开了十年（现在还开）→ have been driving for

zh: 你加油了吗？
en: Have you filled up the car?
alt: Did you get petrol?
Have you put petrol in?
point: 加油 → fill up；问事情做了没 → Have you…

zh: 雨终于停了。
en: It's finally stopped raining.
alt: The rain's finally stopped.
point: 雨停了 → It's stopped raining，it 作主语 + 完成时

zh: 我们明天去徒步。
en: We're going tramping tomorrow.
alt: We're going for a tramp tomorrow.
point: 定好的计划 → We're going…；徒步 → tramping

zh: 我晒伤了。
en: I got sunburnt.
alt: I've got sunburn.
point: 晒伤是一次性的事 → got sunburnt；或说现在的状态 I've got sunburn

zh: 那部电影我看过两遍了。
en: I've seen that movie twice.
alt: I've watched that film twice.
point: 看过两遍 → have seen…twice，次数用完成时

zh: 你最近在追什么剧？
en: What are you watching at the moment?
alt: What shows are you into at the moment?
point: 最近在追 → What are you watching，用进行时

zh: 演唱会七点半开始。
en: The concert starts at half seven.
alt: The concert starts at seven thirty.
point: 节目时间表 → 一般现在时 starts；七点半 → half seven

zh: 你圣诞节打算干嘛？
en: What are you doing for Christmas?
alt: What are your plans for Christmas?
point: 问打算 → What are you doing for…？进行时表计划

zh: 我还没给她买礼物。
en: I haven't bought her a present yet.
alt: I still haven't got her a present.
point: 还没买 → haven't bought…yet，yet 放最后

zh: 他们上个月结婚了。
en: They got married last month.
alt: They tied the knot last month.
point: 结婚（具体时间）→ got married，不说 have married

zh: 宝宝睡着了。
en: The baby's fallen asleep.
alt: The baby's gone to sleep.
point: 睡着了 → has fallen asleep，不是 is sleep

zh: 我妈下周来新西兰。
en: My mum's coming to New Zealand next week.
alt: My mum's flying over to New Zealand next week.
point: 已定的行程 → is coming，进行时表将来

zh: 我女儿今年开始上小学了。
en: My daughter started primary school this year.
alt: My daughter's started school this year.
point: 开始上学是过去的一个时间点 → started

zh: 猫又跑出去了。
en: The cat's got out again.
alt: The cat's escaped again.
point: 跑出去了（现在不在家）→ has got out

zh: 你喂狗了吗？
en: Have you fed the dog?
alt: Did you feed the dog?
point: 喂了吗 → Have you fed；feed-fed-fed

zh: 这只狗我们养了三年了。
en: We've had this dog for three years.
alt: We've had him for three years now.
point: 养了三年 → have had…for，不用 raise

zh: 对不起，我忘了你说过的话。
en: Sorry, I forgot what you told me.
alt: Sorry, I forgot what you said.
point: 你说过 → told（过去时），不用 have told

zh: 我最近压力特别大。
en: I've been really stressed lately.
alt: I've been under a lot of stress lately.
point: 最近一直 → have been…lately

zh: 我从来没这么开心过。
en: I've never been this happy.
alt: I've never felt this happy.
point: 从来没这么…过 → have never been this…

zh: 为了赶项目，我们组这周天天加班。
en: Our team's been working late all week to get the project finished.
alt: We've been staying late every night this week to finish the project.
point: 这周天天（到现在）→ have been working late all week

zh: 我上周升级了手机系统，之后电池就特别不耐用。
en: I updated my phone last week, and the battery's been terrible ever since.
alt: Since I updated my phone last week, the battery hasn't lasted at all.
point: 上周升级 → 过去时；从那以后一直 → has been…ever since

zh: 这家咖啡馆以前是家书店，去年才改的。
en: This café used to be a bookshop until last year.
alt: This café was a bookshop until last year.
point: 以前是（现在不是）→ used to be

zh: 他已经连赢三场了，今晚应该也没问题。
en: He's won three matches in a row, so he should be fine tonight.
alt: He's won his last three games, so tonight should be no problem.
point: 连赢三场（到现在）→ has won three in a row

zh: 我刚从超市回来，结果忘了买牛奶。
en: I've just got back from the supermarket, and I forgot the milk.
alt: I've just come back from Countdown and I forgot to get milk.
point: 刚回来 → have just got back；在店里忘了 → forgot（过去时）

zh: 酒店我们订好了，但机票还没订。
en: We've booked the hotel, but we haven't booked our flights yet.
alt: We've sorted the hotel, but we still haven't booked the flights.
point: 订好了 / 还没订 → have booked / haven't…yet

zh: 我从周一开始吃抗生素，但还是咳嗽。
en: I've been on antibiotics since Monday, but I'm still coughing.
alt: I've been taking antibiotics since Monday, but I've still got a cough.
point: since + 起点 → have been on；还在咳 → I'm still coughing

zh: 我回到家的时候，孩子们已经把晚饭做好了。
en: When I got home, the kids had already made dinner.
alt: By the time I got home, the kids had already cooked dinner.
point: 回家前就做好了 → had already made，过去的过去

zh: 我正准备出门，她就打电话来说不来了。
en: I was just heading out when she rang to say she wasn't coming.
alt: I was about to leave when she called to say she couldn't come.
point: 正准备…就 → was just doing when；转述 → wasn't coming

zh: 我一直以为这张卡没有年费。
en: I always thought this card didn't have an annual fee.
alt: I'd always assumed there was no annual fee on this card.
point: 一直以为（其实不是）→ always thought + 过去时

zh: 面试官说他们周五前会给我答复。
en: The interviewer said they'd get back to me by Friday.
alt: The interviewer said I'd hear from them by Friday.
point: 转述当时说的将来 → said they'd（would），不是 will

zh: 我找了半年工作，终于拿到offer了。
en: I've been job hunting for six months, and I've finally got an offer.
alt: After six months of looking, I've finally got a job offer.
point: 找了半年 → have been job hunting；终于拿到 → have finally got

zh: 我上一份工作干了三年，后来公司裁员了。
en: I worked at my last job for three years before I was made redundant.
alt: I was at my last company for three years until they made me redundant.
point: 已结束的工作 → worked（过去时），不用 have worked

zh: 我报了一个会计夜校班，下周开课。
en: I've signed up for an evening accounting course, and it starts next week.
alt: I've enrolled in a night class in accounting that starts next week.
point: 报了名 → have signed up；课程表 → starts

zh: 考试前一晚，我一直复习到凌晨两点。
en: The night before the exam, I was revising until two in the morning.
alt: I stayed up revising until 2 a.m. the night before the exam.
point: 那晚一直在做 → was revising，过去进行时

zh: 我去图书馆的时候，那本书已经被人借走了。
en: When I went to the library, someone had already borrowed the book.
alt: By the time I got to the library, the book had already been checked out.
point: 去之前就借走了 → had already borrowed

zh: 我们在这套房子住了两年，从来没见过房东。
en: We've lived in this flat for two years and never met the landlord.
alt: We've been in this place for two years and we've never met the landlord.
point: 住了两年 → have lived；从没见过 → have never met

zh: 我们去看房的时候，他们正在刷厨房。
en: When we went to the viewing, they were painting the kitchen.
alt: They were painting the kitchen when we viewed the house.
point: 看房时正在做 → were painting，过去进行时

zh: 我们下周末搬家，你能来帮个忙吗？
en: We're moving house next weekend. Can you come and give us a hand?
alt: We're moving next weekend. Could you come and help?
point: 定好的计划 → We're moving，不说 We will move

zh: 隔壁在装修，已经吵了一个月了。
en: The neighbours are renovating, and it's been noisy for a month.
alt: Next door's doing renovations and it's been loud for a whole month.
point: 正在装修 → are renovating；吵了一个月 → has been noisy

zh: 我早上出门的时候，看见你家的猫在我车上睡觉。
en: When I left this morning, your cat was sleeping on my car.
alt: Your cat was asleep on my car when I went out this morning.
point: 看见时正在 → was sleeping，过去进行时作背景

zh: 下个月我们这条街要搞一次邻里烧烤。
en: Our street's having a neighbourhood barbecue next month.
alt: We're having a street barbecue next month.
point: 已经计划好的活动 → is having，进行时表将来

zh: 我上个月换了宽带公司，现在网速快多了。
en: I switched broadband providers last month, and it's much faster now.
alt: I changed my internet provider last month and it's way quicker now.
point: 上个月换 → switched（过去时）；现在 → 一般现在时

zh: 我已经打了三次客服电话，每次都要等半小时。
en: I've called the helpline three times, and each time I've had to wait half an hour.
alt: I've rung customer service three times and waited half an hour every time.
point: 到现在打了三次 → have called…three times

zh: 电力公司说明天上午九点到十二点停电。
en: The power company says the power will be off from nine to twelve tomorrow.
alt: The lines company says there'll be an outage from nine till twelve tomorrow.
point: 通知的将来 → will be off；says 用现在时转述通知

zh: 我在家等了水管工一整天，他根本没来。
en: I waited in all day for the plumber, but he never showed up.
alt: I stayed home all day waiting for the plumber, and he didn't turn up.
point: 已结束的那天 → waited（过去时）；wait in = 在家等

zh: 洗碗机从昨晚开始一直有怪声。
en: The dishwasher's been making a weird noise since last night.
alt: The dishwasher has been making a strange noise since last night.
point: 从昨晚到现在 → has been making…since

zh: 施工队说他们下周一开工。
en: The builders say they're starting next Monday.
alt: The builders say they'll start next Monday.
point: 对方定好的安排 → they're starting，进行时表将来

zh: 我正在网上填表，页面突然超时了。
en: I was filling in the form online when the page suddenly timed out.
alt: The page timed out while I was filling in the online form.
point: 正在…突然 → was filling in…when + 过去时

zh: 我刚给IRD打了电话，他们说退税已经处理了。
en: I've just rung IRD, and they said my tax refund's been processed.
alt: I just called IRD and they told me my refund has gone through.
point: 刚打了 → have just rung；退税处理好了 → has been processed

zh: 我下周四要去市政府申请停车证。
en: I'm going to the council next Thursday to apply for a parking permit.
alt: Next Thursday I'm going to apply for a parking permit at the council.
point: 已安排的事 → I'm going…，现在进行时表将来

zh: 警察说他们已经抓到那个小偷了。
en: The police said they'd already caught the thief.
alt: The police told me they'd caught the person who did it.
point: 转述过去的话 → said they'd caught，时态往后退一步

zh: 我开车回家的路上，看到前面出了车祸。
en: I was driving home when I saw an accident up ahead.
alt: On my way home, I saw a crash up ahead.
point: 正在开车时看到 → was driving…when I saw

zh: 地震的时候你在干什么？
en: What were you doing when the earthquake hit?
alt: Where were you when the earthquake struck?
point: 发生时在干什么 → What were you doing when…hit

zh: 我的rego上个月就过期了，我都没注意到。
en: My rego ran out last month, and I didn't even notice.
alt: My rego expired last month and I hadn't even noticed.
point: 上个月过期 → ran out（过去时）；rego = 车辆注册

zh: 我以前每天坐公交上班，现在骑车。
en: I used to take the bus to work every day, but now I cycle.
alt: I used to bus to work, but these days I bike.
point: 以前常 → used to；现在的习惯 → 一般现在时

zh: 我已经在路上了，大概十分钟到。
en: I'm on my way, and I'll be there in about ten minutes.
alt: I'm on my way now, so I should be there in ten minutes or so.
point: 在路上 → I'm on my way；十分钟后 → in ten minutes，不是 after

zh: 我们上次爬塔拉纳基山，一直在下雨。
en: It rained the whole time we were on Mount Taranaki.
alt: It poured the whole time we were up Mount Taranaki last time.
point: 那次一直下雨（已结束）→ rained the whole time

zh: 天气预报说今晚会刮大风。
en: The forecast says it's going to be really windy tonight.
alt: Apparently it's going to blow a gale tonight.
point: 有依据的预测 → it's going to be

zh: 你涂防晒霜了吗？今天紫外线很强。
en: Have you put sunscreen on? The UV's really high today.
alt: Have you got sunblock on? The UV is really strong today.
point: 涂了没 → Have you put…on；防晒霜 → sunscreen

zh: 我半年前加入了读书会，到现在读了八本书。
en: I joined the book club six months ago, and I've read eight books since.
alt: I've read eight books since joining the book club six months ago.
point: ago → 过去时 joined；到现在读了 → have read…since

zh: 我们到电影院的时候，电影已经开始十分钟了。
en: The film had been going for ten minutes when we got to the cinema.
alt: By the time we got to the cinema, the movie had already started ten minutes earlier.
point: 到时已持续了十分钟 → had been going for

zh: 这个游戏我玩了整整一个周末。
en: I spent the whole weekend playing this game.
alt: I played this game all weekend.
point: 已过去的周末 → spent…doing（过去时）

zh: 今年春节我们打算回国过。
en: We're going back to China for Chinese New Year this year.
alt: We're heading home to China for Chinese New Year this year.
point: 打算好了 → We're going back，进行时表计划

zh: 我在婚礼上致辞的时候，手一直在抖。
en: My hands were shaking the whole time I was giving my wedding speech.
alt: My hands kept shaking all through my speech at the wedding.
point: 过去一段时间里一直 → were shaking / was giving

zh: 我们已经给她订好了生日蛋糕，她还不知道。
en: We've already ordered her birthday cake, and she has no idea.
alt: We've ordered her a birthday cake already, and she doesn't know yet.
point: 订好了 → have already ordered；她不知道 → has no idea

zh: 我儿子最近长得特别快，裤子都短了。
en: My son's been growing so fast lately that his trousers are too short.
alt: My son's shot up lately and his pants are too short now.
point: 最近一直在长 → has been growing

zh: 我小时候，爷爷每天都送我上学。
en: When I was little, my grandad would take me to school every day.
alt: My grandad used to take me to school every day when I was little.
point: 过去的习惯 → would / used to + 动词原形

zh: 老师说我女儿今天在学校表现很好。
en: The teacher said my daughter had a great day at school today.
alt: Her teacher told me she'd had a really good day at school.
point: 转述 → said + 过去时 had

zh: 我们下周去度假，邻居会帮我们喂猫。
en: We're going on holiday next week, and our neighbour's going to feed the cat.
alt: We're away next week, and our neighbour's feeding the cat.
point: 已安排好的事 → going to / 现在进行时，不用 will

zh: 狗一早上都在挠门，可能是想出去。
en: The dog's been scratching at the door all morning. I think he wants to go out.
alt: The dog has been pawing at the door all morning, so he probably wants out.
point: 一早上都在 → has been scratching all morning

zh: 带猫去看兽医的路上，它一直在叫。
en: The cat was meowing the whole way to the vet.
alt: The cat cried all the way to the vet.
point: 路上一直在 → was meowing the whole way

zh: 我那天说话太冲了，一直想跟你道个歉。
en: I was out of line the other day, and I've been meaning to apologise.
alt: I was too harsh the other day, and I've been wanting to say sorry.
point: 一直想做（还没做）→ have been meaning to

zh: 你今天怎么了？一直都不说话。
en: What's up with you today? You've been really quiet.
alt: Is everything OK? You've hardly said a word all day.
point: 今天到现在一直 → You've been quiet，不用 You are quiet all day

zh: 你一直没回消息，我还以为你生我气了。
en: You didn't reply, so I thought you were upset with me.
alt: I hadn't heard back from you, so I assumed you were angry with me.
point: 以为（当时的想法）→ thought + 过去时 were

zh: 到下个月，我在这家公司就干满十年了。
en: By next month, I'll have worked here for ten years.
alt: Next month I'll have been with the company for ten years.
point: 到将来某时已满…年 → will have worked

zh: 老板进来的时候，我们已经讨论了一个小时，一点进展都没有。
en: We'd been talking for an hour without getting anywhere when the boss walked in.
alt: When the boss came in, we'd already spent an hour going round in circles.
point: 过去某时之前一直在 → had been talking

zh: 这是我这个月第三次被叫去加班了。
en: This is the third time I've been asked to work late this month.
alt: That's the third time this month I've had to stay back.
point: This is the third time 后面要用现在完成时

zh: 我们原定今天上线，结果测试发现了一个大bug。
en: We were supposed to go live today, but testing turned up a major bug.
alt: We were meant to launch today, but we found a big bug in testing.
point: 原定（没实现）→ were supposed to

zh: 你什么时候改的密码？我一上午都登不进去。
en: When did you change the password? I've been locked out all morning.
alt: When was the password changed? I haven't been able to log in all morning.
point: When 问时间点 → did，不能用 have；一上午 → have been locked out

zh: 明天这个时候，我还在给全公司的电脑装新系统。
en: This time tomorrow, I'll still be installing the new system on everyone's laptops.
alt: I'll still be rolling out the new system to everyone's machines this time tomorrow.
point: 将来某时正在做 → will be doing

zh: 等我递交申请的时候，这个职位已经招到人了。
en: By the time I applied, they'd already filled the position.
alt: When I sent in my application, the role had already been filled.
point: 申请之前就招到了 → had already filled

zh: 我在上一家公司带过一个五人团队，所以有一定的管理经验。
en: I managed a team of five at my last company, so I've got some leadership experience.
alt: At my previous job I led a team of five, so I have some management experience.
point: 已离开的公司 → 过去时 managed；现在拥有 → I've got

zh: 他们说两周内会通知我，现在都三周了。
en: They said they'd let me know within two weeks, and it's been three now.
alt: They told me I'd hear back in two weeks, and it's already been three.
point: 转述 → said they'd；都三周了 → it's been three

zh: 我写作业写了好几个小时，结果趴在桌上睡着了。
en: I'd been working on my assignment for hours when I fell asleep at my desk.
alt: After hours of working on my assignment, I nodded off at my desk.
point: 一直在做…然后 → had been working…when + 过去时

zh: 到明年这个时候，我应该已经拿到文凭了。
en: By this time next year, I should have finished my diploma.
alt: I should have my diploma by this time next year.
point: 将来某时已完成 → should have + 过去分词

zh: 自从上了这门课，我的英语口语进步了很多。
en: My spoken English has improved a lot since I started this course.
alt: Since starting this course, my speaking has come a long way.
point: since 后用过去时 started，主句用 has improved

zh: 我刚把地拖完，狗就带着一身泥跑了进来。
en: I'd just mopped the floor when the dog came running in covered in mud.
alt: I'd only just finished mopping when the dog ran in all muddy.
point: 刚做完…就 → had just done when + 过去时

zh: 我以为你已经把垃圾桶推出去了，结果垃圾车都来过了。
en: I thought you'd put the bins out, but the rubbish truck's already been.
alt: I thought you'd taken the bins out, and now we've missed the rubbish truck.
point: 以为你已经 → thought you'd done；车来过了 → has already been

zh: 我春天种的番茄终于开始变红了。
en: The tomatoes I planted in spring are finally starting to turn red.
alt: The tomatoes I put in back in spring have finally started ripening.
point: 正在变化中 → are starting to；种的 → planted（过去时）

zh: 我们六周前就搬走了，押金到现在还没退回来。
en: We moved out six weeks ago, and we still haven't got our bond back.
alt: It's been six weeks since we moved out, and our bond still hasn't been refunded.
point: ago → 过去时 moved out；到现在还没 → still haven't

zh: 中介下周二要来做例行检查，我们得先打扫一下。
en: The property manager's coming round for an inspection next Tuesday, so we'd better tidy up.
alt: We've got a routine inspection next Tuesday, so we need to give the place a clean.
point: 已定的安排 → is coming round；得先 → we'd better

zh: 我们到看房现场的时候，已经有十几个人在排队了。
en: When we got to the viewing, there were already a dozen people waiting.
alt: There were about twelve people queuing by the time we arrived for the viewing.
point: 到时已经在等 → were already waiting，过去进行时

zh: 他们家的树枝伸到我们院子里好几年了。
en: Their tree's been hanging over our fence for years now.
alt: Branches from their tree have been coming over into our yard for years.
point: 好几年了（还在）→ has been hanging over for years

zh: 我正要过去敲门投诉，他们就把音乐关了。
en: I was about to go and knock on their door when they turned the music off.
alt: I was just going to go over and complain when they turned it down.
point: 正要…就 → was about to…when + 过去时

zh: 你听说了吗？街角那家人下个月要搬走了。
en: Have you heard? The family on the corner are moving out next month.
alt: Did you hear the family on the corner are leaving next month?
point: 听说了吗 → Have you heard；要搬走 → are moving out

zh: 我们这个月的电费翻了一倍，可是用电并没有变多。
en: Our power bill's doubled this month, even though we haven't been using any more.
alt: Our power bill is twice what it was last month, but we haven't used any more.
point: 翻了一倍 → has doubled；一直没多用 → haven't been using more

zh: 装光纤的师傅本来说今天上午来，到现在都没出现。
en: The fibre technician was supposed to come this morning, but there's been no sign of him.
alt: The fibre guy was meant to turn up this morning, but he still hasn't shown up.
point: 本来说要来（没来）→ was supposed to；到现在 → there's been no sign

zh: 自从换了手机套餐，我每个月都省了二十块左右。
en: Since I changed my mobile plan, I've been saving about twenty dollars a month.
alt: I've saved around twenty bucks a month since switching phone plans.
point: since + 过去时，主句 have been saving

zh: 这个水龙头我已经修过两次了，还在滴水。
en: I've fixed this tap twice already, and it's still dripping.
alt: I've already had a go at this tap twice and it's still leaking.
point: 修过两次 → have fixed twice；还在滴 → is still dripping

zh: 等装修队干完，我们差不多要花掉三万块了。
en: By the time the builders finish, we'll have spent about thirty grand.
alt: We'll have spent close to thirty thousand dollars by the time the builders are done.
point: by the time + 现在时，主句 will have spent

zh: 上次那个木匠活干得特别细，下次我还找他。
en: The carpenter I had last time did a really tidy job, so I'll get him back.
alt: The builder we used last time did great work, so I'll call him again.
point: 上次 → 过去时 did；下次还找 → I'll

zh: 物流显示包裹已经送到了，可我根本没收到。
en: The tracking says my parcel's been delivered, but it's not here.
alt: Apparently my parcel was delivered, but I haven't got it.
point: 显示已送达 → says it's been delivered（现在完成时）

zh: 我买的时候还是原价，第二天就打五折了。
en: I paid full price for it, and the next day it went on sale at half price.
alt: I bought it at full price, and then it was half off the very next day.
point: 按顺序讲过去的事 → 两个动作都用过去时

zh: 这家店我经常来，可从来没见过这么多人。
en: I come here all the time, but I've never seen it this busy.
alt: I shop here a lot, but it's never been this packed before.
point: 经常来 → 一般现在时；从没见过 → have never seen

zh: 我们等了半天菜，结果还上错了。
en: We'd been waiting ages for our food, and then they brought out the wrong dishes.
alt: After waiting forever, we got the wrong order.
point: 之前一直在等 → had been waiting；然后 → 过去时

zh: 我订了明天晚上七点四个人的位子。
en: I've booked a table for four at seven tomorrow night.
alt: I've made a booking for four people at 7 p.m. tomorrow.
point: 订好了（对明天有效）→ have booked

zh: 这家店换了老板以后，味道就大不如前了。
en: The food hasn't been as good since the restaurant changed hands.
alt: Since the new owners took over, the food's gone downhill.
point: since + 过去时，主句 hasn't been；换老板 → change hands

zh: 我已经三个月没动过存款了，挺有成就感的。
en: I haven't touched my savings in three months, and it feels great.
alt: It's been three months since I dipped into my savings, and I'm pretty proud of that.
point: 三个月没动 → haven't touched…in three months

zh: 我刚发现上个月的会员费被扣了两次。
en: I've just noticed I was charged twice for my membership last month.
alt: I just realised they took my membership fee twice last month.
point: 刚发现 → have just noticed；上个月被扣 → was charged

zh: 我们的固定利率下个月到期，到时候得重新锁定。
en: Our fixed rate comes off next month, so we'll need to refix.
alt: Our fixed term ends next month, so we'll have to lock in a new rate.
point: 日程上的事 → comes off；到时要 → we'll need to

zh: 我的居留申请已经在移民局放了五个月了。
en: My residence application's been sitting with Immigration for five months now.
alt: My residence application has been in the queue for five months.
point: 放了五个月（还在等）→ has been sitting…for

zh: 表我上周就交了，可他们说没有记录。
en: I handed the form in last week, but they say they've got no record of it.
alt: I submitted the form last week, but apparently they haven't got it.
point: 上周交 → 过去时；他们现在说 → say + 现在时

zh: 我的IRD号码等了三个星期，昨天终于寄到了。
en: I'd been waiting three weeks for my IRD number, and it finally came yesterday.
alt: After waiting three weeks, I finally got my IRD number yesterday.
point: 之前一直在等 → had been waiting；昨天到 → came

zh: 医生问我这种头疼持续多久了。
en: The GP asked me how long I'd been having these headaches.
alt: The doctor wanted to know how long I'd had the headaches.
point: 转述 how long have you been → how long I'd been

zh: 我上次看牙已经是两年前的事了。
en: The last time I went to the dentist was two years ago.
alt: It's been two years since I last saw a dentist.
point: 上次…是 → The last time I + 过去时

zh: 我原本约了周三拍片子，后来医院改到下周了。
en: I was booked in for an X-ray on Wednesday, but the hospital's moved it to next week.
alt: My X-ray was meant to be on Wednesday, but they've pushed it back a week.
point: 原本约了 → was booked in；改了（现在的结果）→ has moved

zh: 我回到家，发现门被人撬了。
en: When I got home, I found that someone had broken in.
alt: I came home to find the house had been broken into.
point: 发现之前就发生了 → had broken in

zh: 我已经报警了，他们说马上派人过来。
en: I've already called the police, and they're sending someone over now.
alt: I've rung 111, and they've got someone on the way.
point: 已经报了 → have called；正在派 → are sending

zh: 我们正在吃饭，烟雾报警器突然响了。
en: We were having dinner when the smoke alarm suddenly went off.
alt: The smoke alarm went off in the middle of dinner.
point: 正在吃饭 → were having dinner；报警器响 → went off

zh: 我转了快一个小时才找到停车位。
en: I'd been driving around for nearly an hour before I finally found a park.
alt: I drove around for almost an hour before I found a park.
point: 找到之前一直在转 → had been driving around；车位 → a park

zh: 我的车下周要做WOF，希望一次就能通过。
en: My car's due for its WOF next week, and hopefully it'll pass first time.
alt: My WOF's due next week, so fingers crossed it passes first go.
point: 到期 → is due for；希望会 → hopefully it'll

zh: 你上次换机油是什么时候？可能该换了。
en: When did you last get the oil changed? It might be overdue.
alt: When was the last time you had the oil changed? It could be due.
point: 上次什么时候 → When did you last…，用过去时

zh: 我们等了三个小时登机，最后航班还是取消了。
en: We'd been waiting to board for three hours when they cancelled the flight.
alt: After three hours of waiting to board, the flight got cancelled.
point: 之前一直在等 → had been waiting…when

zh: 明天这个时候，我们应该已经落地奥克兰了。
en: By this time tomorrow, we'll have landed in Auckland.
alt: We should be in Auckland by this time tomorrow.
point: 将来某时已完成 → will have landed

zh: 我们本来想住民宿，可是全都订满了。
en: We'd hoped to stay at a B&B, but they were all booked up.
alt: We wanted to stay in a B&B, but everywhere was full.
point: 本来希望（没实现）→ had hoped to

zh: 我们帐篷刚搭好，就下起了倾盆大雨。
en: We'd only just put the tent up when it started bucketing down.
alt: We'd barely pitched the tent when it started pouring.
point: 刚…就 → had only just done when；倾盆大雨 → bucketing down

zh: 我从来没在冬天走过汤加里罗，有点心里没底。
en: I've never done the Tongariro Crossing in winter, so I'm a bit nervous.
alt: I've never tramped the Tongariro Crossing in winter, so I'm a bit unsure.
point: 从没…过 → have never done

zh: 最近一直又热又干，草坪都黄了。
en: It's been so hot and dry lately that the lawn's gone brown.
alt: We haven't had any rain for ages, and the grass has turned brown.
point: 最近一直 → It's been；变黄了 → has gone brown

zh: 他从十二岁开始就一直打橄榄球。
en: He's been playing rugby since he was twelve.
alt: He's played rugby ever since he was twelve.
point: since 后用过去时 was，主句 has been playing

zh: 我跑到一半，鞋带断了。
en: I was halfway through my run when my shoelace snapped.
alt: My shoelace broke halfway through my run.
point: 正跑到一半 → was halfway through…when + 过去时

zh: 我已经报了明年的半马，打算下个月开始练。
en: I've entered next year's half marathon, and I'm going to start training next month.
alt: I've signed up for the half marathon next year, so I'll start training next month.
point: 报了名 → have entered；打算 → going to

zh: 我学画画快一年了，终于敢给别人看了。
en: I've been learning to paint for nearly a year, and I'm finally brave enough to show people.
alt: I've been painting for almost a year now, and I'm finally confident enough to share it.
point: 学了快一年 → have been learning for

zh: 这本书我还没看完，你别剧透啊。
en: I haven't finished the book yet, so don't tell me what happens!
alt: I'm not done with the book yet, so no spoilers!
point: 还没看完 → haven't finished…yet

zh: 乐队上台的时候，我们已经站着等了一个小时了。
en: By the time the band came on, we'd been standing there for an hour.
alt: We'd been on our feet for an hour when the band finally came on.
point: 那时已经站了一小时 → had been standing for

zh: 我们说好六点见，他到现在还没来。
en: We said we'd meet at six, but he still hasn't turned up.
alt: We agreed to meet at six, and there's still no sign of him.
point: 说好的 → said we'd；到现在还没 → still hasn't

zh: 我们是十年前在语言学校认识的，从那以后一直是好朋友。
en: We met at language school ten years ago, and we've been friends ever since.
alt: We've been mates since we met at language school ten years ago.
point: 认识 → met；从那以后一直 → have been…ever since

zh: 周六的烧烤你来吗？在Sam家办。
en: Are you coming to the barbecue on Saturday? It's at Sam's place.
alt: Will you make it to Sam's barbecue on Saturday?
point: 问对方计划 → Are you coming，进行时

zh: 我已经二十年没在国内过春节了，都快忘了是什么感觉。
en: I haven't spent Chinese New Year in China for twenty years, so I've almost forgotten what it's like.
alt: It's been twenty years since I celebrated Chinese New Year back home.
point: 二十年没… → haven't…for；快忘了 → have almost forgotten

zh: 等你收到这张卡片的时候，我应该已经在飞机上了。
en: By the time you get this card, I'll already be on the plane.
alt: I'll be on the plane by the time this card reaches you.
point: by the time + 现在时 get，主句 I'll be

zh: 去年圣诞节我们是在海边过的，还烤了肉。
en: Last Christmas we spent the day at the beach and had a barbie.
alt: We had a barbecue at the beach last Christmas.
point: 「是…的」讲过去 → 过去时 spent / had

zh: 我爸妈下个月过来，要住三个月。
en: My parents are coming over next month, and they're staying for three months.
alt: My parents are visiting next month and staying three months.
point: 已安排的行程 → are coming / are staying

zh: 我去接他的时候，他已经在门口等了好久了。
en: When I picked him up, he'd been waiting at the gate for ages.
alt: He'd been standing at the gate for ages by the time I got there.
point: 接之前一直在等 → had been waiting for ages

zh: 自从有了孩子，我们就再也没去电影院看过电影。
en: We haven't been to the movies since the kids were born.
alt: We haven't seen a film at the cinema since we had the kids.
point: since + 过去时 were born，主句 haven't been

zh: 上周我们把狗送去寄养了，它好像瘦了。
en: We put the dog in kennels last week, and he seems to have lost weight.
alt: The dog was in kennels last week and looks like he's lost weight.
point: 好像已经 → seems to have + 过去分词

zh: 小猫是我们上个月从SPCA领养的，现在已经把家当成自己的了。
en: We adopted the kitten from the SPCA last month, and she's already taken over the house.
alt: We got the kitten from the SPCA last month and she already rules the house.
point: 上个月领养 → adopted；已经 → has already taken over

zh: 我遛狗的时候，它突然挣脱绳子跑了。
en: I was walking the dog when he slipped his lead and ran off.
alt: The dog got out of his lead and ran off while I was walking him.
point: 正在遛狗 → was walking；突然发生 → 过去时 slipped / ran off

zh: 我本来想告诉你的，可一直没找到合适的机会。
en: I was going to tell you, but the right moment never came up.
alt: I meant to tell you, but I never found the right time.
point: 本来想（没做成）→ was going to

zh: 那次吵架以后，她就一直没理我。
en: She hasn't spoken to me since we had that argument.
alt: She's been ignoring me ever since our fight.
point: since + 过去时 had，主句 hasn't spoken

zh: 我第一次上台讲话的时候，紧张得要命。
en: The first time I spoke in front of an audience, I was absolutely terrified.
alt: I was so nervous the first time I gave a speech.
point: 讲过去那一次 → The first time I + 过去时，不用完成时

zh: 我上周在休假，那封邮件还没来得及看，今天下班前给你回复。
en: I was on leave last week, so I haven't had a chance to read that email yet. I'll get back to you by the end of the day.
alt: I was off last week and haven't got to that email yet, but I'll reply before I finish today.
point: 上周 → was on leave；还没来得及 → haven't had a chance；答应 → I'll

zh: 这个问题我们已经排查了两天，目前看来是上周那次更新引起的。

alt: We've spent two days on this, and at this stage it looks like last week's update caused it.
point: 排查了两天 → have been troubleshooting；上周的更新 → was caused（过去时）

zh: 我打电话是想把今晚的预订改到八点，我们有个朋友下班比较晚。
en: I'm ringing to move our booking tonight to eight, because one of our friends is finishing work late.
alt: I'm calling to push our booking back to eight tonight, as one of us won't finish work till later.
point: 打电话来是为了 → I'm ringing to；今晚的安排 → is finishing late

zh: 我们队这个赛季一场都没赢过，教练说下周要是再输就换人。
en: We haven't won a single game this season, and the coach says he'll make changes if we lose again next week.
alt: We're yet to win a game this season, and the coach has said he'll shake things up if we lose next week.
point: 这个赛季（还没结束）→ haven't won；if 从句用现在时 lose

zh: 这件外套我上周六在你们店买的，回家后才发现袖子上有个洞。
en: I bought this jacket here last Saturday, but I didn't notice the hole in the sleeve until I got home.
alt: I got this jacket from you last Saturday and only spotted the hole in the sleeve when I got home.
point: 过去时叙述 + 直到…才 → didn't notice…until

zh: 我们本来周四回来，但航空公司改了航班，所以要到周五才能到家。
en: We were meant to be flying back on Thursday, but the airline's changed our flight, so we won't get home till Friday.
alt: We were due back on Thursday, but our flight's been changed, so now we're not getting in until Friday.
point: 本来 → were meant to be；改了（影响现在）→ has changed；won't…till

en: This cough has been hanging around for nearly a month, so the pharmacist suggested I go and see my GP.
alt: I've had this cough for almost a month, so the chemist told me to see a doctor.
point: 拖了快一个月 → has been hanging around；建议（已发生）→ suggested

zh: 我们这周末打算收拾一下后院，你要是有空就过来一起烧烤吧。
en: We're going to sort out the back garden this weekend, so if you're free, come over for a barbecue afterwards.
alt: We're tidying up the backyard this weekend, so pop round for a barbie if you're free.
point: 打算 → going to；if 从句用现在时 you're free

zh: 我知道我好久没联系你了，最近又搬家又换工作，忙得团团转。
en: I know I haven't been in touch for ages. I've been run off my feet with moving house and starting a new job.
alt: Sorry I've been so quiet lately. Between moving and starting a new job, I've been flat out.
point: 好久没联系 → haven't been in touch；最近一直忙 → have been flat out

zh: 我刚查了账户，钱昨天就扣走了，可是对方说还没收到。
en: I've just checked my account, and the money went out yesterday, but they're saying they haven't received it.
alt: I've just had a look and the payment left my account yesterday, but they say it hasn't come through.
point: 刚查过 → have just checked；昨天扣走 → went out（过去时）

zh: 我在现在这家公司干了四年，学到了很多，但觉得是时候迎接新的挑战了。
en: I've been with my current company for four years and learnt a lot, but I feel it's time for a new challenge.
alt: I've been at my current job for four years and I've learnt heaps, but I'm ready for a new challenge.
point: 现在还在职 → have been with；不说 I work in this company four years

zh: 我上周五面试的，他们说这周出结果，所以我一直在等电话。
en: I had the interview last Friday and they said they'd decide this week, so I've been waiting for the phone to ring.
alt: My interview was last Friday, and they said I'd hear this week, so I've been sitting by the phone.
point: 面试 → had（过去）；转述 → they'd；一直在等 → have been waiting

zh: 我已经接受了另一家公司的offer，下个月一号入职，所以只能婉拒你们了。
en: I've already accepted an offer elsewhere and I'm starting on the first of next month, so I'll have to turn this one down.
alt: I've taken another offer and I start on the first of next month, so unfortunately I'll have to decline.
point: 已接受 → have accepted；入职安排 → I'm starting；只能 → I'll have to

zh: 我这学期一直在打工，所以作业老是拖到最后一刻才交。
en: I've been working part-time all semester, so I keep leaving my assignments until the last minute.
alt: I've had a part-time job all semester, which is why I always end up doing assignments at the last minute.
point: 这学期一直在 → have been working；反复发生 → keep doing

zh: 我是报名截止前一天才交的材料，好在赶上了。
en: I only sent in my enrolment the day before applications closed, but luckily I made it in time.
alt: I didn't submit my enrolment until the day before the deadline, but thankfully I got in.
point: 「是…才…的」讲过去 → 过去时 sent / closed / made it

zh: 这门考试我已经挂了两次，不过这次准备得充分多了，挺有信心的。
en: I've failed this exam twice, but I've been preparing much more thoroughly this time, so I'm feeling pretty confident.
alt: I've already failed this exam twice, but I've put in a lot more work this time and I feel good about it.
point: 挂了两次 → have failed twice；这次一直在准备 → have been preparing

zh: 我们搬进来的时候烤箱就已经坏了，所以退房时不应该从押金里扣钱。
en: The oven was already broken when we moved in, so they shouldn't be taking it out of our bond.
alt: The oven was already faulty when we moved in, so it shouldn't come out of our bond.
point: 入住时已经坏了 → was already broken when we moved in

zh: 我们在这儿住了三年，从来没拖欠过房租，希望房东能考虑续租。
en: We've been here three years and never once been late with the rent, so we're hoping the landlord will renew our lease.
alt: We've lived here for three years and always paid the rent on time, so hopefully the landlord will extend our tenancy.
point: 住了三年 → have been here；从没拖欠 → (have) never been late

zh: 我有个室友下个月要搬走，我们正在找人接他的房间。
en: One of my flatmates is moving out next month, so we're looking for someone to take over his room.
alt: A flatmate's leaving next month, so we're on the hunt for someone to take his room.
point: 已定的搬走 → is moving out；正在找 → are looking for

zh: 昨晚十一点我去敲他们门的时候，他们的派对已经开了五个小时了。
en: By the time I knocked on their door at eleven last night, their party had been going for five hours.
alt: Their party had been going for five hours when I finally went over and knocked at eleven last night.
point: 那时已经持续了五小时 → had been going for

zh: 我们社区小组下个月要组织一次海滩清洁活动，你有兴趣一起来吗？
en: Our community group's organising a beach clean-up next month. Would you be keen to come along?
alt: We're running a beach clean-up with the community group next month. Are you interested in joining us?
point: 已在筹备的活动 → is organising；有兴趣 → keen

zh: 我好几天没看到隔壁那位老太太了，她平时每天早上都在院子里。
en: I haven't seen the old lady next door for a few days, and she's usually out in her garden every morning.
alt: I haven't spotted the elderly lady next door in days, and normally she's in her garden every morning.
point: 好几天没看到 → haven't seen for；平时 → 一般现在时

zh: 我打电话是因为我们家从昨天下午开始就没热水了，开关我们也已经检查过了。
en: I'm calling because we haven't had any hot water since yesterday afternoon, and we've already checked the switch.
alt: I'm ringing because there's been no hot water since yesterday afternoon, and we've already tried the switch.
point: 从昨天下午起没有 → haven't had…since；已经检查 → have already checked

zh: 这个账号我上个月就注销了，可这个月你们还是扣了我的钱。
en: I closed this account last month, but you've still charged me this month.
alt: I cancelled this account last month, yet you've still taken a payment this month.
point: 上个月 → closed（过去）；这个月（还没过完）→ you've charged

zh: 我在线上等了四十分钟，刚要接通，电话就断了。
en: I'd been on hold for forty minutes, and just as I got through, the call dropped out.
alt: After forty minutes on hold, the line dropped right as someone answered.
point: 之前一直在等 → had been on hold；就在那时 → just as + 过去时

zh: 我们找了三家施工队要报价，到现在只有一家回复了。
en: We've asked three builders for quotes, and so far only one of them has got back to us.
alt: We've requested quotes from three builders, but only one has replied so far.
point: so far → 现在完成时 has got back to us

zh: 电工上周来修过一次，可是这个开关现在又不灵了。
en: The electrician came out last week to fix it, but the switch has stopped working again.
alt: We had the sparky out last week, but the switch is playing up again.
point: 上周来过 → came out；又坏了（现在）→ has stopped working

zh: 我本来想自己修，看了几个视频以后，还是决定找专业的人来。
en: I was going to fix it myself, but after watching a few videos I decided to get a professional in.
alt: I'd planned to do it myself, but a few YouTube videos convinced me to call in a pro.
point: 本来想 → was going to；决定（已发生）→ decided

zh: 我两个月前就申请了护照续签，网上的状态一直显示“处理中”。
en: I applied to renew my passport two months ago, and the online status has said 'in progress' ever since.
alt: I put in my passport renewal two months ago, and it's been showing 'in progress' online the whole time.
point: ago → applied；从那以后一直显示 → has said…ever since

zh: 我打电话是想确认一下，我上周寄的材料你们收到了没有。
en: I'm just calling to check whether you've received the documents I posted last week.
alt: I'm ringing to make sure the documents I sent last week have arrived.
point: 收到没有 → have received；上周寄的 → posted（过去时）

zh: 我原来约的是周二上午，但那天我要上班，能改到周五吗？
en: My appointment was booked for Tuesday morning, but I'm working that day. Could I move it to Friday?
alt: I was booked in for Tuesday morning, but I've got work then. Is Friday possible instead?
point: 原来约的 → was booked；那天要上班（安排）→ I'm working

zh: 我在超市停车场倒车出位的时候，另一辆车倒过来撞上了我。
en: I was reversing out of a park at the supermarket when another car backed into me.
alt: Another car reversed into me while I was backing out of a space in the supermarket car park.
point: 正在倒车 → was reversing；被撞（突发）→ backed into me

zh: 我把包落在公交上了，已经给失物招领打过电话，但还没人交上来。
en: I left my bag on the bus, and I've already rung lost property, but no one's handed it in yet.
alt: I left my bag on the bus. I've called lost property already, but it hasn't been handed in.
point: 落下 → left（过去）；已经打过 → have rung；还没人交 → no one's handed in yet

zh: 暴风雨过后，我们这条街已经停电十几个小时了，谁也不知道什么时候能来电。
en: Our street's been without power for over twelve hours since the storm, and nobody knows when it'll be back on.
alt: We've had no power on our street for more than twelve hours since the storm, and there's no word on when it'll be restored.
point: 停电十几小时（还在停）→ has been without power

zh: 我上周刚换的新轮胎，结果已经被扎了一次。
en: I only got new tyres last week, and I've already had a puncture.
alt: I put new tyres on just last week, and I've had a flat already.
point: 上周 → got（过去）；已经…一次 → have already had

zh: 这周我坐的火车天天晚点，我已经跟老板打过招呼，说可能还会迟到。
en: My train's been late every day this week, so I've warned my boss I might be late in again.
alt: The train's run late every day this week, so I've given my manager a heads-up that I could be late again.
point: 这周天天 → has been late every day this week；已打招呼 → have warned

zh: 修车行打电话说我的车今天下午就能修好，我下班去取。
en: The garage rang to say my car will be ready this afternoon, so I'll pick it up after work.
alt: The mechanic called and said the car's ready this afternoon, so I'll grab it after work.
point: 打来电话 → rang；能修好 → will be ready；当场决定 → I'll

zh: 我们原本计划这周末去露营，但听说有暴风雨要来，已经取消了。
en: We'd planned to go camping this weekend, but we've called it off because there's a storm on the way.
alt: We were going to go camping this weekend, but we've cancelled since a storm's coming.
point: 原本计划 → had planned；已经取消 → have called it off

zh: 我们走了五个小时才到小屋，那时天已经黑了。
en: We'd been tramping for five hours by the time we reached the hut, and it was already dark.
alt: It took us five hours to reach the hut, and by then it was already dark.
point: 到达前已走了五小时 → had been tramping for

zh: 自从我每天早上去海边散步，睡眠好多了。
en: Since I started walking along the beach every morning, I've been sleeping much better.
alt: I've slept a lot better ever since I started my morning beach walks.
point: since + 过去时 started，主句 have been sleeping

zh: 我学萨克斯一年多了，下个月第一次在俱乐部演出。
en: I've been learning the sax for just over a year, and next month I'm doing my first gig at the club.
alt: I've been playing saxophone for a bit over a year, and I've got my first performance at the club next month.
point: 学了一年多 → have been learning；定好的演出 → I'm doing

zh: 那部剧我看到第三季就弃了，后来听说结局还挺不错的。
en: I gave up on that show halfway through season three, but I've heard the ending's pretty good.
alt: I stopped watching that series in season three, but apparently the ending's really good.
point: 弃剧（过去）→ gave up；听说 → I've heard

zh: 我的理发师下个月要搬去国外了，我在她那儿剪了五年头发。
en: My hairdresser's moving overseas next month, and I've been going to her for five years.
alt: My hairdresser is leaving the country next month, and she's been cutting my hair for five years.
point: 已定的搬家 → is moving；去了五年 → have been going to her

zh: 我们在一起十年了，终于决定明年结婚。
en: We've been together for ten years, and we're finally getting married next year.
alt: After ten years together, we're finally tying the knot next year.
point: 在一起十年 → have been together；已定的婚期 → are getting married

zh: 我本来想给她买束花，可花店已经关门了，最后只好买了巧克力。
en: I was going to get her flowers, but the florist had already shut, so I ended up getting chocolates.
alt: I'd meant to buy her flowers, but the florist was closed by then, so I got chocolates instead.
point: 本来想 → was going to；已经关门 → had already shut；最后只好 → ended up

zh: 周五公司的圣诞聚会你去吗？听说今年请了乐队。
en: Are you going to the work Christmas do on Friday? I've heard they've booked a band this year.
alt: Are you coming to the Christmas party on Friday? Apparently there's a live band this year.
point: 问安排 → Are you going；听说 → I've heard + they've booked

zh: 我女儿这学期一直在学校合唱团唱歌，下周五第一次登台演出。
en: My daughter's been singing in the school choir this term, and they're doing their first performance next Friday.
alt: My daughter joined the school choir this term, and they've got their first concert next Friday.
point: 这学期一直 → has been singing；定好的演出 → are doing

zh: 我妈来了两个月，一直在帮我们带孩子，下周就回国了。
en: Mum's been here for two months helping with the kids, and she's flying home next week.
alt: My mum's been staying for two months to help with the kids, and she goes home next week.
point: 来了两个月 → has been here；订好的航班 → is flying

zh: 孩子们在后座吵了一个小时，我差点调头直接开回家。
en: The kids had been fighting in the back seat for an hour, so I nearly turned round and drove home.
alt: After an hour of the kids squabbling in the back, I almost turned the car around and went home.
point: 那之前一直在吵 → had been fighting；差点 → nearly + 过去时

zh: 我们出去度假的时候，宠物保姆每天会来两次喂猫。
en: While we're away, the pet sitter's going to come in twice a day to feed the cats.
alt: The pet sitter will pop in twice a day to feed the cats while we're on holiday.
point: while 从句用现在时表将来；已安排 → is going to

zh: 兽医说狗这一年胖了三公斤，得让它减肥了。
en: The vet said the dog's put on three kilos over the past year, so he needs to go on a diet.
alt: According to the vet, the dog has gained three kilos in the last year and needs to lose some weight.
point: over the past year → has put on，完成时

zh: 我们签租约之前，房东就已经同意我们养猫了。
en: The landlord had already agreed to us having a cat before we signed the lease.
alt: Before we signed the tenancy agreement, the landlord had already said yes to the cat.
point: 签约之前就同意 → had already agreed

zh: 我最近总觉得特别累，可能是这段时间工作揽得太多了。
en: I've been feeling really run-down lately. I think I've been taking on too much at work.
alt: I've been so worn out lately, probably because I've taken on too much at work.
point: 最近一直 → have been feeling；这段时间 → have been taking on

zh: 我知道你一直在为这件事担心，不过我保证会处理好的。
en: I know you've been worrying about this, but I promise I'll sort it out.
alt: I know this has been weighing on you, but I promise I'll deal with it.
point: 一直在担心 → have been worrying；保证会 → I'll

zh: 那天我不是故意冲你发火的，我那会儿刚收到一个坏消息。
en: I didn't mean to snap at you the other day. I'd just had some bad news.
alt: Sorry for snapping at you the other day. I'd just found out some bad news.
point: 那天 → didn't mean to；在那之前刚 → had just had

zh: 我想说明一下，项目延期是因为供应商到现在还没交付我们三月份订的设备。
en: I'd like to explain that the project has been delayed because the supplier still hasn't delivered the equipment we ordered in March.
alt: To clarify, the delay is due to the supplier, who has yet to deliver the equipment we ordered back in March.
point: 延期了 → has been delayed；三月订的 → ordered（过去时）

zh: 到本周末，我们团队将完成剩余所有系统的迁移工作。
en: By the end of this week, our team will have completed the migration of all the remaining systems.
alt: Our team expects to have finished migrating all the remaining systems by the end of the week.
point: 截至将来某时已完成 → will have completed

zh: 过去一年里，我一直负责新员工的入职培训，到目前为止已经带了六名新人。
en: Over the past year, I've been responsible for onboarding new staff, and I've mentored six new starters so far.
alt: For the last twelve months I've been in charge of onboarding, and I've mentored six new employees to date.
point: over the past year / so far → 现在完成时，不用一般过去时

zh: 自从贵公司上周二推送更新以来，我们的打印服务一直无法正常运行。
en: Since your update was pushed out last Tuesday, our printing service has not been working properly.
alt: Our printing service hasn't worked properly since your update last Tuesday.
point: since + 过去时 was pushed out，主句 has not been working

zh: 故障发生时，我们团队正在进行例行维护，所以没有第一时间注意到警报。
en: When the outage occurred, our team was carrying out routine maintenance, so the alerts weren't noticed straight away.
alt: The outage happened while we were doing routine maintenance, which is why the alerts were missed at first.
point: 故障时正在做 → was carrying out；正式报告用 occurred

zh: 我们今天上午已重置了所有受影响用户的密码，并将在明天之前完成全面的安全审查。
en: We reset the passwords of all affected users this morning and will have completed a full security review by tomorrow.
alt: All affected users had their passwords reset this morning, and a full security review will be finished by tomorrow.
point: 今天上午（已过去）→ reset；by tomorrow → will have completed

zh: 过去五年，我一直在奥克兰一家中型软件公司担任系统管理员。
en: For the past five years, I've been working as a systems administrator for a mid-sized software company in Auckland.
alt: I've spent the last five years as a systems administrator at a medium-sized software firm in Auckland.
point: for the past five years → have been working，面试常用

zh: 我是在招聘网站上看到这个职位的，其实我关注贵公司的发展已经好几年了。
en: I saw this role advertised online, and I've actually been following your company's work for several years.
alt: I came across this position on a job site, though I've been keeping an eye on your company for a few years now.
point: 看到（一次）→ saw；关注了好几年 → have been following

zh: 特此正式通知您，我已决定辞职，最后一个工作日为三月十五日。
en: I'm writing to formally let you know that I've decided to resign, and my last day will be the fifteenth of March.
alt: Please accept this as formal notice of my resignation. My final day of work will be 15 March.
point: 已决定 → have decided；最后一天 → will be；开头 I'm writing to

zh: 由于上个月我大部分时间都在住院，没能按时提交作业，特此申请延期。
en: As I was in hospital for most of last month, I wasn't able to submit my assignment on time, and I'd like to request an extension.
alt: I was hospitalised for much of last month and couldn't hand in my assignment on time, so I'm requesting an extension.
point: 上个月住院 → was in hospital；没能 → wasn't able to

zh: 我去年已完成二级证书课程，现在希望报读三级会计文凭。
en: I completed the Level 2 certificate last year, and I would now like to enrol in the Level 3 accounting diploma.
alt: Having completed the Level 2 certificate last year, I'm now hoping to enrol in the Level 3 diploma in accounting.
point: 去年完成 → completed（不用 have completed）；现在想 → would now like

zh: 截至今天，我仍未收到关于我学分认定申请的任何答复。
en: As of today, I still haven't received any response regarding my application for credit recognition.
alt: I have yet to hear back about my credit recognition application.
point: 截至今天仍未 → As of today, still haven't received

zh: 上周的暴雨导致我家屋顶漏水，此后客厅天花板出现了明显的水渍。
en: Last week's heavy rain caused a leak in our roof, and the lounge ceiling has since developed significant water stains.
alt: Our roof leaked in last week's heavy rain, and there are now noticeable water stains on the lounge ceiling.
point: 上周 → caused；此后出现 → has since developed

zh: 我们的回收桶已经连续三周没有被收走，而我们每周都按时放在了路边。
en: Our recycling bin hasn't been collected for three weeks in a row, even though we've put it out on time every week.
alt: Our recycling hasn't been picked up for three consecutive weeks, despite the bin being out on time each week.
point: 连续三周没收 → hasn't been collected for three weeks

zh: 我们订的橱柜原定上个月交货，但到现在为止仍没有收到任何进展通知。
en: The kitchen cabinets we ordered were due to be delivered last month, but we still haven't had any update.
alt: Our cabinets were supposed to arrive last month, and we've heard nothing since.
point: 原定（过去的计划）→ were due to be；到现在 → still haven't had

zh: 浴室漏水的问题我三周前就报告了，但到现在还没有人来修。
en: I reported the leak in the bathroom three weeks ago, but no one has come to repair it yet.
alt: It's been three weeks since I reported the bathroom leak, and it still hasn't been fixed.
point: 三周前 → reported；到现在还没 → no one has come yet

zh: 特此通知，我们将在六月三十日固定租期结束时搬出。
en: I'm writing to give notice that we'll be moving out when our fixed-term tenancy ends on 30 June.
alt: Please take this as notice that we'll be vacating the property at the end of our fixed term on 30 June.
point: 正式通知 → we'll be moving out；when 从句用现在时 ends

zh: 自入住以来，我们一直按时缴纳房租，并把房子保持得很整洁。
en: Since we moved in, we have always paid the rent on time and kept the property in good condition.
alt: We've paid our rent on time and looked after the property well ever since we moved in.
point: since we moved in → have always paid，主句用完成时

zh: 过去两个月，邻居一直把车停在我们车道口，有好几次我们都没法把车开出去。
en: For the past two months, our neighbour has been parking across our driveway, and on several occasions we've been unable to get out.
alt: Our neighbour has repeatedly blocked our driveway over the last two months, and we've been stuck several times.
point: 两个月来一直 → has been parking；好几次 → have been unable

zh: 我们一直很珍惜和你们的邻里关系，所以想在动工之前先跟你们商量换围栏的事。
en: We've always valued having you as neighbours, so we wanted to talk to you about replacing the fence before any work begins.
alt: We've always appreciated being your neighbours, so we'd like to discuss the new fence with you before we start.
point: 一直珍惜 → have always valued；before 从句用现在时 begins

zh: 我们的社区花园项目自去年成立以来，已经吸引了五十多名志愿者参与。
en: Since it was set up last year, our community garden project has attracted more than fifty volunteers.
alt: Our community garden has drawn over fifty volunteers since it started last year.
point: since it was set up → 主句 has attracted

zh: 就这张账单，我已经联系过贵公司四次，但问题至今仍未解决。
en: I have contacted your company four times about this bill, and the issue has still not been resolved.
alt: This is my fourth time contacting you about this bill, and it remains unresolved.
point: 联系过四次 → have contacted；仍未解决 → has still not been resolved

zh: 我十月一日就搬到了新地址，但贵公司一直在按旧地址向我收费。
en: I moved to my new address on the first of October, but you have continued to bill me for the old property.
alt: Although I moved out on 1 October, I'm still being charged for my previous address.
point: 具体日期 → moved；此后一直 → have continued to bill

zh: 我的合同本月底到期，希望在到期之前和你们商量续约的条件。
en: My contract expires at the end of this month, and I'd like to discuss renewal terms before it runs out.
alt: My contract is up at the end of the month, so I'd like to talk about renewing before then.
point: 合同日期 → expires；before 从句用现在时 runs out

zh: 工程原定八月完工，但到目前为止，浴室部分甚至还没有开工。
en: The work was scheduled to be finished in August, but so far the bathroom hasn't even been started.
alt: The job was meant to be done by August, yet work on the bathroom hasn't even begun.
point: 原定 → was scheduled to；so far → hasn't been started

zh: 这台洗碗机是我们十个月前买的，还在保修期内，但最近已经三次出现同样的故障。
en: We bought this dishwasher ten months ago, so it's still under warranty, but it has broken down three times recently with the same fault.
alt: This dishwasher is only ten months old and still under warranty, yet it's had the same fault three times.
point: ago → bought；三次故障 → has broken down three times

zh: 收到贵公司报价时，我们已经接受了另一家的报价，所以这次就不合作了。
en: By the time your quote arrived, we had already accepted one from another company, so we won't be going ahead this time.
alt: We'd already accepted another quote by the time yours came through, so we won't be proceeding on this occasion.
point: 报价来之前 → had already accepted；婉拒 → won't be going ahead

zh: 我于十一月三日在贵公司网站订购了一台吸尘器并已全额付款，但至今仍未收到。
en: I ordered a vacuum cleaner from your website on 3 November and paid in full, but it has not yet arrived.
alt: On 3 November I bought a vacuum cleaner on your website and paid in full, but I have yet to receive it.
point: 具体日期 → ordered / paid；至今未到 → has not yet arrived

zh: 我已经按照客服的要求把商品寄回，可三周过去了，退款仍然没有到账。
en: I returned the item as your customer service team instructed, but three weeks later the refund still hasn't come through.
alt: I sent the item back as requested by your team, and three weeks on I still haven't been refunded.
point: 寄回 → returned；三周后仍未到账 → still hasn't come through

zh: 我在贵店购物已经十多年了，这是我第一次需要投诉。
en: I have been a loyal customer of your store for over ten years, and this is the first time I have ever needed to complain.
alt: I've shopped with you for more than a decade, and this is the first complaint I've ever had to make.
point: 十多年 → have been；this is the first time + 现在完成时

zh: 上周六我们在贵餐厅用餐，我事先已经告诉服务员我对坚果过敏，结果还是上了一道含坚果的菜。
en: We dined at your restaurant last Saturday and, despite having told the waiter about my nut allergy, I was served a dish containing nuts.
alt: When we ate with you last Saturday, I was given a dish with nuts in it even though I'd told the waiter about my allergy.
point: 事先已告知 → having told（完成分词）；上周六 → 过去时

zh: 我们公司计划十二月十五日举办年终聚餐，届时预计有三十人左右参加。
en: Our company is holding its end-of-year dinner on 15 December, and we're expecting around thirty people to attend.
alt: We're planning our end-of-year work dinner for 15 December and expect about thirty guests.
point: 已定的活动 → is holding；预计 → are expecting

zh: 感谢您的反馈，我们已经和当晚值班的员工谈过，并将重新检讨我们的订位流程。
en: Thank you for your feedback. We've spoken to the staff who were working that evening and will be reviewing our booking process.
alt: Thanks for letting us know. We've talked to the team on shift that night and we'll be looking at how we handle bookings.
point: 已谈过 → have spoken；当晚在班 → were working；将会 → will be reviewing

zh: 我发现上周有两笔我从未授权的交易，所以已经把这张卡冻结了。
en: I noticed two transactions last week that I never authorised, so I've already frozen the card.
alt: There were two payments last week that I didn't authorise, and I've already put a freeze on the card.
point: 上周发现 → noticed；已冻结 → have frozen；freeze-froze-frozen

zh: 过去五年我们从未逾期还过房贷，希望银行能考虑给我们更优惠的利率。
en: We haven't missed a single mortgage payment in the past five years, so we'd like you to consider offering us a better rate.
alt: We've made every mortgage repayment on time for the last five years, and we'd appreciate it if you could offer us a sharper rate.
point: 过去五年从未… → in the past five years + haven't missed

zh: 我从2015年起就一直在交KiwiSaver，现在想了解一下首次购房取款的流程。
en: I've been contributing to KiwiSaver since 2015, and I'd now like to find out about withdrawing funds for my first home.
alt: I've been a KiwiSaver member since 2015 and would like to know how to make a first-home withdrawal.
point: since 2015 → have been contributing，不用 contribute

zh: 我二月份就申请了工作签证延期，此后一直没有任何消息，希望能了解一下进度。
en: I applied to extend my work visa in February and haven't heard anything since, so I'd appreciate an update.
alt: I submitted my work visa extension in February and have had no news since. Could you please update me?
point: 二月申请 → applied；此后没消息 → haven't heard anything since

zh: 我们九月份申请了建筑许可，到现在已经等了将近四个月。
en: We applied for building consent in September and have now been waiting almost four months for a decision.
alt: Our building consent application went in back in September, and we've been waiting nearly four months for an outcome.
point: 九月申请 → applied；等了将近四个月 → have been waiting

zh: 我的护照在旅行途中遗失，已经向当地警方报了案。
en: My passport was lost while I was travelling overseas, and I have already reported it to the local police.
alt: I lost my passport during my trip and have already filed a report with the local police.
point: 旅行途中 → while I was travelling；已报案 → have already reported

zh: 我上个月在一次工伤事故中扭伤了背，此后一直无法正常工作。
en: I injured my back in a workplace accident last month and have been unable to work normally since then.
alt: Since hurting my back in an accident at work last month, I haven't been able to work as usual.
point: 上个月受伤 → injured；此后一直 → have been unable since

zh: 我五个月前被转诊到骨科，但到现在还没有收到预约。
en: I was referred to the orthopaedic clinic five months ago, but I still haven't been given an appointment.
alt: It's been five months since my referral to orthopaedics, and I'm still waiting for an appointment.
point: 五个月前转诊 → was referred；到现在没给 → still haven't been given

zh: 我母亲下个月将从中国过来住三个月，想咨询一下她期间如果生病该如何看医生。
en: My mother will be visiting from China for three months, and I'd like to know what she should do if she needs to see a doctor.
alt: My mum is coming over from China for three months, so I'm enquiring about how she can see a doctor if she needs one.
point: 安排好的探亲 → will be visiting；if 从句用现在时 needs

zh: 小偷是在我们外出度假期间闯进来的，我们直到昨天回家才发现。
en: The burglary took place while we were away on holiday, and we didn't discover it until we got home yesterday.
alt: Someone broke in while we were on holiday, and we only found out when we got back yesterday.
